title: MinerU Document Parser
description: Convert PDFs, images, Office, HTML and EPUB files into clean Markdown and structured JSON with MinerU 4.0.

input.name: VRAM MinerU plans with (GB)
input.description: GB MinerU plans with, not the card's size. vLLM gets 6/this of the card, at least 0.1: LOWER gives it MORE. Keep it above 8; at 6 vLLM takes the whole card, below 6 more. Empty = card size.

input.name: S3 endpoint URL (optional)
input.description: Endpoint URL for an S3-compatible bucket. Only needed when callers request large outputs via S3. Works with AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, and MinIO.

input.name: S3 bucket name (optional)
input.description: Name of the S3-compatible bucket to upload to. Only needed when callers request large outputs via S3.

input.name: S3 access key ID (optional)
input.description: Access key ID for the S3-compatible bucket. Only needed when callers request large outputs via S3. Stored on the worker, never exposed to jobs.

input.name: S3 secret access key (optional)
input.description: Secret access key for the S3-compatible bucket. Only needed when callers request large outputs via S3. Stored on the worker, never exposed to jobs.

input.name: Max concurrent jobs per worker
input.description: Concurrent jobs per worker. Default 1 is safe everywhere. See the scaling guide before raising on smaller GPUs.

input.name: Refresh worker after N jobs
input.description: Recycle the worker after this many successful jobs to release VRAM fragmentation. 0 (default) disables.

input.name: Refresh worker after N cumulative pages
input.description: Recycle the worker after this many cumulative pages. 0 (default) disables. Only bounded page slices contribute.

input.name: Max pages per job
input.description: Largest page range one job may request. 0 (default) means no ceiling. Applies to explicit ranges only, not full-document parses.

input.name: Input roots for volume_path
input.description: Comma-separated absolute paths a volume_path input may live under. Empty uses /runpod-volume, /workspace, /worker and /tmp.

input.name: Allow non-routable file_url targets
input.description: Set to 1 when file_url points at a host inside your own network. Default requires a publicly routable address.

input.name: Disable the probe response
input.description: Set to 1 so probe:true jobs return an error instead of the worker's filesystem and model-cache layout. On by default; any value except 0/false/no/off disables it.

input.name: Presigned output URL lifetime
input.description: Seconds a transport='s3' output URL stays valid. Default 3600. Clamped to 60-604800; unparseable values fall back to the default.

input.name: Worker log format
input.description: Worker log output format. JSON is easier to filter in dashboards; text is human-readable for local development.

input.name: MinerU processing window (pages)
input.description: Pages per processing window. Lower reduces VRAM, higher trades VRAM for throughput. Empty = MinerU's default.

input.name: MinerU PDF render timeout (seconds)
input.description: Seconds before MinerU kills a hung PDF page render. Raise for very complex PDFs. Empty = default 300.

input.name: MinerU PDF render threads
input.description: CPU threads for PDF rasterization. Raise on high-vCPU pods for image-heavy PDFs. Empty = MinerU's default (3).

input.name: Skip eager warmup at boot
input.description: Set to 1/true/yes to bypass the eager warmup. Default off (warmup runs). Disable only for debugging cold-start ordering.

input.name: Tier to warm at boot
input.description: Which tier the boot warmup loads. Should match the tier most callers will use. Default advanced.

input.name: OCR mode for boot warmup
input.description: OCR mode (auto, txt or ocr) of the warmup parse. Default ocr, which is also the job default.

input.name: OTLP/HTTP endpoint (telemetry trigger)
input.description: Base URL of an OTLP/HTTP backend (Axiom, Honeycomb, Tempo, etc.). Empty = telemetry off. The SDK appends /v1/traces, /v1/logs, /v1/metrics.

input.name: Default OTLP headers
input.description: Default headers sent with OTLP requests. CSV of key=value pairs. Per-signal values below override this setting.

input.name: OTLP headers for traces
input.description: Override headers for trace export. Axiom requires a dedicated Events dataset for traces.

input.name: OTLP headers for logs
input.description: Override headers for log export. Axiom requires a dedicated Events dataset for logs.

input.name: OTLP headers for metrics only
input.description: Override headers for metrics export only. Set when your backend uses a separate metrics dataset (e.g. Axiom's x-axiom-metrics-dataset).

input.name: OTel service.name
input.description: Service name attached to every signal. Override if you deploy multiple endpoints into one backend and need to tell them apart in queries.

input.name: Extra OTel resource attributes
input.description: Comma-separated extra resource attributes, e.g. deployment.environment=prod,team=ml. Merged with the built-in runpod.* and service.* attrs.
